 Singers Arijit Singh and Diljit Dosanjh have unveiled sharply contrasting prices for their India concerts. Strong demand for Arijit's premium packages highlights significant interest in high-end ticketing options.
 Advertisement Arijit Singh and Diljit Dosanjh are set to perform at high-capacity venues, including Ahmedabad’s Narendra Modi Stadium. (Credit: Instagram/@arijitsingh/Reuters) By: India Today Entertainment Desk New Delhi , Oct 21, 2026 20:00 IST Last Updated Oct 21, 2026 20:00 IST Published by Anurag Bohra Oct 21, 2026 19:59 IST Singers Arijit Singh and Diljit Dosanjh are preparing for major multi-city stadium tours across India, with ticketing structures revealing a vast gap in maximum pricing strategies. While the top-tier VIP package for Arijit’s upcoming tour reaches Rs 11.8 lakh, Diljit has capped his highest ticket price at Rs 18,000. Both artists are set to perform at high-capacity venues, including Ahmedabad’s Narendra Modi Stadium. Arijit announced a nine-city national tour running from January to May 2027 to mark his 20th year in the music industry. The announcement follows his decision in January to step back from playback singing to concentrate on independent musical projects. The stadium concerts will feature a selection of his popular tracks, including Agar Tum Saath Ho, Tum Hi Ho and Vida Karo. Tickets for his shows range from Rs 999 for entry-level seating in Ahmedabad to Rs 11.8 lakh for a 15-seater lounge at Mumbai’s Mahalaxmi Racecourse. According to official ticketing partner thumpN, high-end hospitality tables across cities are priced between Rs 7 lakh and Rs 10 lakh. These group packages include sofa seating, complimentary alcohol, dedicated entry points, separate washroom access, and a short-form video generated by a designated content creator. Approximately 60 per cent of the premium table categories have been booked. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Team Innovation (@team.innovation) Arijit’s tour is projected to cover nine cities, commencing in Ahmedabad on January 9, 2027, before moving to Chandigarh on 23 January and Jaipur on 7 February. Subsequent dates include Mumbai on February 20, Bengaluru on 13 March, New Delhi on March 27, Pune on April 10, Indore on May 1, and concluding in Hyderabad on May 15. In contrast, Diljit Dosanjh has adopted a lower price ceiling for the Indian leg of his ongoing Aura World Tour , following his 2024 Dil-Luminati Tour , which generated an estimated Rs 943 crore in revenue. After dates across Europe and North America, Diljit’s domestic leg starts in Delhi-NCR on November 1, visiting Indore on November 15, Ahmedabad on November 21, Mumbai on November 27, Bengaluru on November 29, and Lucknow on December 5, with an additional Chandigarh date to be confirmed. View this post on Instagram A post shared by DILJIT DOSANJH (@diljitdosanjh) 
 advertisement ❮ ❯ Read Full Story Arijit Singh first gained national attention after participating in the music reality show Fame Gurukul in 2005. Over the subsequent two decades, he established himself as one of Hindi cinema’s primary playback vocalists, lending his voice to chart-topping tracks including Channa Mereya , Tum Hi Ho , Ae Dil Hai Mushkil , Gerua , Bulleya , Kesariya , Apna Bana Le , and Jhoome Jo Pathaan . His recent work includes the track Jai Jai Ram for director Nitesh Tiwari’s upcoming epic film Ramayana , featuring actors Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, Yash, Ravie Dubey and Sunny Deol. The film is scheduled for a theatrical release on November 5, 2026. Diljit Dosanjh has established a dual career across music and cinema over the past two decades, building an extensive domestic and international fanbase through stadium performances and film releases. Meanwhile, he was recently seen in Imtiaz Ali’s Main Vaapas Aaunga (2026) , sharing screen space with an ensemble cast featuring Naseeruddin Shah, Sharvari, and Vedang Raina. - Ends Read more | Diljit Dosanjh announces 7-city Aura Tour across India from November.
